name: Noir Mystery: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Noir Mystery look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, film noir still, hard chiaroscuro, venetian-blind shadows across the face, rain-slick streets, fedoras and trench coats, cigarette smoke, black and white or heavily desaturated, single hard key light, deep blacks, wet reflective surfaces
negative_prompt: bright saturated colour, sunny daylight, modern technology, cartoon, cheerful mood, text, watermark
